metadata.source: AI Agent Suspicious Child Process Spawn Detection.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: AI Agent Suspicious Child Process Spawn Detection
properties.description:
Detects suspicious child processes spawned by AI agent runtimes
(OpenClaw, Moltbot, ClawDBot, AutoGPT, BabyAGI).
Focuses on administrative tooling, encoded command execution,
persistence creation, defense evasion, and credential-related activity.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("openclaw","moltbot","clawdbot","autogpt","babyagi")
| where FileName in (
    "powershell.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe",
    "rundll32.exe","mshta.exe","reg.exe",
    "net.exe","net1.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe",
    "schtasks.exe","sc.exe"
)
  or ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "-enc","-encodedcommand",
    "Invoke-WebRequest",
    "DownloadString",
    "Add-MpPreference",
    "reg add",
    "vssadmin",
    "whoami /priv"
)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), EventCount=count()
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
